text.tspan: Two branches changed the same line. Git will not guess which one you meant.
What Git writes into your file
everything below this is YOUR branch's version
the divider between the two versions
everything above this is the OTHER branch's version
Your job: decide what the line should say, then delete all three marker lines. A conflict is a question, not an error.
